name: Zero Ultima
driverConfig: 1 × double-magnetic circuit DMT4 Ultra dynamic (PU edge + coated Ti composite dome)
pros: Excellent Harman-leaning tuning for the price
insight: Zero Ultima is a strong ultra-budget single-dynamic from Tanchjim. It tracks a natural, balanced signature with good midrange and is frequently recommended as one of the safer low-cost options for beginners.
